When does the revolving credit facility under the Credit Agreement mature?

message.content:
The revolving credit facility under the Credit Agreement matures on "June 28, 2026." This information is found in section 2.4(c)(i):  
"Revolving Credit Loans. The Borrowers shall repay each Revolving Credit Loan in the principal amount thereof on the earliest to occur of (i) the Maturity Date (which, in the case of Revolving Credit Loans, shall be June 28, 2026) ..."
